scope: Read source and existing paired VAL results only. No model/inference/training/GPU execution. Only this JSON and its Chinese report are newly written.
verified_from_source: use_scene=False disables global CLS, static patch attention, dynamic attention, local query/region condition/BPS, learned feedback, and enabled analytical guidance together. It does not isolate one scene mechanism.

First proposal _core_pass receives global CLS, static patch and dynamic attention before local_geometry runs. Local physical feedback therefore cannot alone explain an already-corrupted first core proposal.
Global CLS is added to timestep embedding and enters U-Net AdaGN blocks. Its magnitude is not explicitly limited by observed/reference confidence or timestep.

Patch/dynamic scene projections are added to the observation/camera/reference condition. Validity masks are present, but there is no explicit reference-preservation, per-joint distance/uncertainty or diffusion-timestep gate on these additions.
Occupancy is indexed [Y,X,Z]; ViT token flatten is [Xpatch,Zpatch]; valid mask and patch_centres use the same order. Grid is 24x48x48, metric range X/Z [-6.4,6.4), Y [-3.1,1.7), centres Y=-0.7.

EXO observation positions and scene points share origin/yaw anchor. Positions are m/2 and local queries restore x2; scene points and FK vertices are metric. Canonical cache yaw conversion and local frame delta use matching rotations.
Zero-occupancy patches receive normal ViT embeddings/positions and participate in transformer before the patch output mask. CLS has no separate observed-coverage/unknown gate.
There is no global/dynamic branch-specific public config flag in this model. patch_enabled, local_enabled and feedback_enabled have distinct narrower scopes.
not_established: No definite axis/order/metre-versus-half-metre code defect was found in the paths statically traced. This is not an end-to-end proof that every released/calibrated source bundle aligns.
No single branch is proven to cause the noisy yoga collapse. Full scene ON/OFF changes several branches simultaneously.
Unknown/empty patch semantics and unbounded scene/reference competition are architectural risks, not verified root causes.
Frozen-backbone EXO versus EGO camera-centred occupancy distributions may differ; no distribution analysis or data-level realignment check was run here.
Turning a branch off can cause an out-of-distribution condition. A gain on the known failure alone would not validate deployment or a paper result.

branch_isolation_proposal_only.followup_only_if_needed: If no single branch explains it, combine the three removals to isolate local-scene-only generation. A first-core-only version can then separate a corrupted proposal from final-core conditioning. These are separate declared variants, not the first minimum diagnostic.
branch_isolation_proposal_only.reuse: Follow process-scoped evaluator/contextmanager pattern in ops/scene_feedback_policy.py; extend paired frozen evaluator once in an unsealed ops module, do not edit sealed model files or create per-case scripts.
branch_isolation_proposal_only.controls: Require empty _sampling_scene before/after; same checkpoint SHA, exact known inputs/reference/scene and DDIM seed; restore hooks/flags even on error. No GT consulted for gating; GT only in existing metric computation.
branch_isolation_proposal_only.acceptance: Use existing predeclared clean/noisy VAL identities across all three datasets, including yoga and wipingchairs. Compare hidden/visible MPJPE, reference degradation count, stance-foot speed, acceleration, and first-core raw/FK pose diagnostics. No selection on the single known bad window. No additional evaluation was run by this audit.

existing_validation_evidence.scope: 12 predeclared EXO VAL windows (4 distinct recordings per corpus), clean/noisy and sceneON/OFF;3 EGO retention anchors;162 predictions. Not full20/fixed100/VAL or TEST.
existing_validation_evidence.interpretation: The TRAIN-only position nondegradation loss did not repair the large scene-ON yoga failure; foot-speed and acceleration also worsen versus baseline in this case. No candidate is promoted by this report.
